items.title: What’s News: Business & Finance
items.summary: WHATS NEWS BUSINESS FINANCE L3Harris Technologies, the contractor that overhauled a Qatari jet for use as Air Force One, replaced Christopher Kubasik as chairman and CEO after an investigation found that he violated the company’s code of conduct.

items.title: Ousted L3Harris CEO Chris Kubasik forfeits $45 million—but he’ll still walk away with $80 million in stock and options
items.summary: The ex-CEO was previously forced to resign from Lockheed Martin after a 2012 ethics investigation confirmed he had a personal relationship with a subordinate.

items.title: L3Harris Ousts CEO After Investigation Into Conduct
items.summary: The defense contractor that overhauled the Qatar-donated jet to be Air Force One has replaced Christopher Kubasik.

items.title: L3Harris ousts CEO Kubasik over conduct violation
